name: B10-0424/2026 – Recital E – Am 82
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: E. whereas the spread of state-level disinformation and ideological profiling normalises Islamophobia; whereas women wearing religious clothing face higher rates of racial discrimination than those who do not, especially when looking for work (45 % compared to 31 %), with the rate rising to 58 % for young women (16-24 years) wearing religious clothing;
